cli.intro: OpenEDA — create, inspect, edit and export schematic design documents on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create a native design document and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a design document and print its committed revision and sheets
cmd.diff: Compare two design documents and report added, removed and modified sheets, components, nets and buses
cmd.annotate: Renumber component reference designators by leading prefix and placement order, skipping references without a prefix
cmd.translate: Translate selected components and wires of a sheet by an offset
cmd.list: List components, nets and wires of a design document
cmd.symbols: List the symbol library a design document uses, with pin counts and missing footprints
cmd.library: Read a KiCad .kicad_sym symbol library and report its symbols, units and pins
cmd.library-check: Validate a KiCad .kicad_sym symbol library and report duplicate symbols, empty symbols, repeated pin numbers and nameless pins
cmd.connectivity: Report what each net connects, the pins no net reaches and the per-sheet wire totals
cmd.trace: Trace the read-only connection path between two REF.PIN pins
cmd.stats: Report deterministic per-sheet and design-wide object counts, BOM rows and buses
cmd.inspect: Run electrical rule checks on a design document
cmd.export: Project a design document to a supported exchange format
cmd.import: Import a KiCad schematic into a native design document
cmd.netlist: Import a KiCad netlist or compare one with a design document
cmd.netlist-import: Import a KiCad .net netlist into a native design document
cmd.netlist-diff: Compare a design document with a KiCad .net netlist
cmd.undo: Undo the newest edit of a design document and save it in place
cmd.redo: Redo the newest undone edit of a design document and save it in place
cmd.design-set: Set title, drawing revision, company and date in place
cmd.component-list: List the components placed on a sheet
cmd.component-show: Show one placed component with its placement, custom properties and per-pin nets
cmd.component-add: Add a component to a design document in place
cmd.component-copy: Copy a placed component under a new reference in place
cmd.component-duplicate: Duplicate a placed component under the next free reference in place
cmd.component-move: Move a placed component in place
cmd.component-update: Update the value, footprint or placement of a placed component in place
cmd.component-rotate: Rotate a placed component by a relative angle in place
cmd.component-mirror: Mirror a placed component on the x or y axis in place
cmd.component-footprint: Assign or clear the footprint of a placed component in place
cmd.component-property-set: Assign or replace one custom key/value property of a placed component in place
cmd.component-property-remove: Remove one custom property from a placed component in place
cmd.component-property-list: List the custom properties of one placed component
cmd.component-pin-type: Assign or clear the electrical role of one component pin in place
cmd.component-pin: Add, remove, rename or swap the pins of a placed component
cmd.component-pin-add: Add a pin to a placed component in place
cmd.component-pin-remove: Remove a pin that no net or no-connect flag still uses
cmd.component-pin-rename: Rename a component pin and update the nets and no-connect flags that referenced it
cmd.component-pin-swap: Swap the net connections of two pins of a placed component; each pin takes the other pin's connection
cmd.component-delete: Delete a placed component and its net nodes in place
cmd.net-show: Show one net's nodes, wires, labels and matching bus and net class
cmd.net-audit: Report the per-net health: nodes, pins, wires, labels, length and warning codes
cmd.net-list: List the nets of a sheet with their REF.PIN nodes
cmd.net-connect: Connect REF.PIN nodes to a named net in place
cmd.net-rename: Rename a declared net across every sheet; wires, labels, net-class and bus alias assignments follow
cmd.net-merge: Merge one net into another and repoint the wires that named it
cmd.net-derive: Name every connected wire group of a sheet in place
cmd.net-disconnect: Remove REF.PIN nodes from a net while keeping the net and its wires
cmd.net-delete: Delete a net and detach the wires that named it
cmd.bus-add: Declare a bus the netlist expands into member nets
cmd.bus-update: Rename a bus, change its width or replace its aliases
cmd.bus-list: List the buses a design document declares
cmd.bus-remove: Remove a declared bus by id, name or alias
cmd.net-class: Manage net classes and their routing attributes
cmd.net-class-add: Declare or replace a net class with width, clearance, via and net/bus assignments
cmd.net-class-list: List the net classes a design document declares
cmd.net-class-remove: Remove a net class by id or name
cmd.reference-add: Declare or replace the expected reference prefix of a component class
cmd.reference-list: List reference prefix rules and component class assignments
cmd.reference-remove: Remove the reference prefix rule of one component class
cmd.reference-assign: Assign a placed component to a component class
cmd.reference-unassign: Clear the component class of a placed component
cmd.variant: Manage BOM variants and their do-not-populate lists
cmd.variant-add: Declare or replace a BOM variant with DNP designators and value overrides
cmd.variant-list: List the BOM variants a design document declares
cmd.variant-remove: Remove a BOM variant by name
cmd.wire-add: Draw a wire segment between two points in place
cmd.wire-update: Change the endpoints or net of a wire segment in place
cmd.wire-split: Split a wire segment into two at a point on the segment
cmd.wire-merge: Merge two touching collinear wires of the same net into one segment
cmd.wire-list: List the wire segments drawn on a sheet
cmd.wire-delete: Delete a wire segment in place
cmd.junction-add: Add a junction (connection dot) to a design document in place
cmd.junction-list: List the junctions of a sheet in 0-based index order
cmd.junction-delete: Delete the junction at a 0-based index in place
cmd.junction-move: Move the junction at a 0-based index in place
cmd.no-connect-add: Add a no-connect flag, optionally marking one component pin as deliberately open
cmd.no-connect-list: List the no-connect flags of a sheet in 0-based index order
cmd.no-connect-delete: Delete the no-connect flag at a 0-based index in place
cmd.text-add: Add a free text annotation to a design document in place
cmd.text-list: List the text annotations of a sheet in 0-based index order
cmd.text-update: Change the content or placement of the text annotation at a 0-based index in place
cmd.text-delete: Delete the text annotation at a 0-based index in place
cmd.text-move: Move the text annotation at a 0-based index in place
cmd.label: Edit schematic net labels
cmd.label-add: Add one net label with an optional cross-sheet scope in place
cmd.label-list: List the net labels of a sheet in document order
cmd.label-update: Change the text, placement, scope or style of one net label by id in place
cmd.label-delete: Delete one net label by id in place
cmd.sheet-add: Add an empty sheet to a design document in place
cmd.sheet-list: List every sheet with its object counts
cmd.sheet-delete: Delete an empty sheet in place
cmd.hierarchy-add: Declare one hierarchical sheet symbol in place
cmd.hierarchy-list: List the hierarchical sheet symbols of a design document
cmd.hierarchy-check: Check the hierarchy against child documents without changing them
cmd.hierarchy-remove: Remove one hierarchical sheet symbol in place
cmd.hierarchy-port-add: Add a port to a hierarchical sheet symbol in place
cmd.hierarchy-port-remove: Remove a port from a hierarchical sheet symbol in place
cmd.gui: Open the OpenEDA Studio window on the native design

opt.title: Design title
opt.rev: Drawing revision label from the title block, for example A
opt.company: Company or organisation in the title block
opt.template: Template the design starts from (only blank is implemented)
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: erc, electrical, drivers, pin_types, bus, nets, connectivity, dangling, footprints, clearance, power, references (drc is unsupported)
opt.component-class: Component class name, for example resistor
opt.prefix: Expected reference designator prefix, one to eight uppercase letters, for example R or TP
opt.severity: Comma-separated finding overrides in code=level form, level error, warning, info or off
opt.waive: Comma-separated accepted findings: code, code@objectId or code@sheetId/objectId
opt.format: Export target: net, net_csv, net_hier, net_class, net_length, spice, spice_subckt, svg, pdf, bom, bom_json, bom_html, report, json, kicad_sch, kicad_sym or a drawing (block_diagram, sheet_overview, pinout_chart, symbol_library, net_topology, power_distribution, bom_drawing, bom_drawing_pdf, net_xref, net_xref_pdf, hierarchy, erc); kicad_pcb and gbr are unsupported
opt.as: Reference designator of the copy, for example R2
opt.footprint: Footprint text, for example Resistor_SMD:R_0805_2012Metric (empty clears it)
opt.key: Custom property key, for example MPN
opt.property-value: Custom property value; an empty string is stored as an empty value
opt.clear: Clear the current value instead of setting one
opt.dx: Offset added to the X coordinate of every selected object
opt.dy: Offset added to the Y coordinate of every selected object
opt.refs: Comma-separated reference designators of the components to translate
opt.angle: Relative rotation in degrees added to the current rotation
opt.axis: Mirror axis in the component's local frame: x flips left-right, y flips top-bottom
opt.library-pins: Print every symbol pin as a unit, number, name and electrical type row
opt.pin-to: New pin name, for example ANODE
opt.sheet: Sheet id or name (defaults to the first sheet)
opt.hierarchy-file: Child schematic file name, for example power.kicad_sch
opt.direction: Port direction: input, output, bidirectional, tri_state or passive
opt.name: New name
opt.wire-index-a: 0-based position of the wire that keeps its identity
opt.wire-index-b: 0-based position of the wire that is removed
opt.from: Start point as x,y, for example 0,0
opt.to: End point as x,y, for example 20,0
opt.net: Net name or id, for example VCC (an empty value clears the wire net)
opt.target: Net that survives a merge, by id or name
opt.source: Net absorbed into the merge target, by id or name
opt.nodes: Comma-separated REF.PIN nodes, for example R1.1,C1.1
opt.bus: Bus id or name, for example DATA
opt.dnp: Comma-separated reference designators that are not populated, for example R2,R5
opt.variant: BOM variant to apply; only bom, bom_json and bom_html accept one
opt.variant-values: Comma-separated value overrides in ref=value form, for example R1=22k
opt.width: Number of member nets the bus expands to
opt.aliases: Comma-separated alternate bus names that resolve to the same bus, for example D
opt.net-class-name: Net class name, for example HighSpeed
opt.net-class-width: Trace width for the net class, greater than zero
opt.clearance: Clearance to neighbouring copper for the net class (zero means no requirement)
opt.via: Via diameter for the net class (zero means no via is declared)
opt.nets: Comma-separated declared net names assigned to the class
opt.buses: Comma-separated declared bus names or aliases assigned to the class
opt.index: 0-based position inside the sheet's junction or text list
opt.label-id: Net label id, for example label-1
opt.scope: Label scope: local, global or hierarchical (defaults to local)
opt.justify: Horizontal justification: left, right or center (defaults to left)
